content_of_post_to_answer: What helped you become more confident in yourself?
answer: What changed my view of confidence is realizing it is less about feeling certain and more about trusting yourself to handle uncertainty. Many people wait to feel confident before acting, but confidence usually appears afterward, as evidence collected from keeping promises to yourself. The quiet shift happens when you stop asking, “Do others approve of me?” and start asking, “Can I rely on myself?” Confidence is built through self-trust, not self-perfection.
